name: checklist
description: A paper chit list: each item gets a blue-ballpoint tick or a red-pen cross, written in sequence. Title sits on the field above the chit. Optional `grow` (default false): the chit lands holding only the first row and lengthens downward as each later row is written; the final size is reserved, so the title never shifts. Rows unclip once open, so short shots never cut a row or its pen mark.
